BUG_FOUND_LIVE|generate_node's condition template emits `current >= config.Minimum` unconditionally, which is invalid C# when the blackboard read type is Bool (bool has no >= operator) -- caught live when the first generate_node call in this session's live proof used blackboardReadType=Bool, produced a real CS0019 compile error. Worked around for this proof by using a numeric type (UInt32) instead, per this card's own Forbidden-changes clause (gate work must not patch a production gap found here). Disclosed as a new, real P6-009 template defect, not fixed by this gate -- see known-limitations.md.

OPERATIONAL_NOTE|analyze_and_compile_node's own two-call design assumes Unity's normal file-watcher promptly notices an external write and begins compiling; in this fully headless, unfocused automation session the write sat as external_changes_dirty:true until an explicit Unity MCP refresh_unity call was issued, after which compilation proceeded normally. Not a defect -- a real characteristic of driving Unity headlessly rather than interactively, worth knowing for future live verifications.

DISCLOSED_GAP_1|Trace inspection: the roadmap exit criterion's literal wording ("inspects a trace") could not be demonstrated -- P6-008 already found no production code wires a real running native tree into a trace channel, deferred to P6-015 (still Draft). Every other step of the exit criterion was demonstrated for real. Put to the owner directly via AskUserQuestion before this gate began verification; decision: accept Phase 6 with this gap explicitly disclosed, mirroring P5-010's own acceptance of Phase 5 with two disclosed scope reductions.

DISCLOSED_GAP_2|Node discoverability after generation: aibt_search_nodes/aibt_get_node_contract both returned zero/not-found for the custom node this same live session had just generated, compiled, tested, and applied via aibt_apply_node. Root cause confirmed by reading source: these discovery tools build their registry via NodeRegistryBuilder.CreateWithBuiltIns(), which only ever includes the hardcoded BuiltInNodeManifests.All list -- nothing wires an applied custom node's shard into that same registry. P6-009's own test_node tool proves registry-materializability through a different, separate path (GeneratedShardMetadataMaterializer/GeneratedNodeRegistry.Build), never claiming discovery-tool visibility. This is a new, concrete manifestation of the already-tracked P6-017 gap (per-project leaf-registration mechanism, still Draft) -- not previously demonstrated end-to-end until this gate's own live session. Materially affects the roadmap exit criterion's "without... guessing node contracts" clause for any node an agent itself just generated. Disclosed here rather than silently smoothed over; not fixed by this gate per its own Forbidden-changes clause.
